summary.intent: Bootstrap release-please with proper tags to fix an excessive changelog on PR #427, align api-client package versions with the API version, and expose the API version on the /health endpoint as a quick task to test the new release system.
summary.outcome: Successfully bootstrapped release-please with 15 tags eliminating the history-wide changelog, aligned api-client versions to 0.35.0, made OpenAPI version dynamic, exposed version on /health endpoint with a shared version module, and fixed merge commit false positives in CI conventional commit parsing. PR #429 is up with generated model updates uncommitted at session end.

repo: release-please without bootstrap tags treats the entire commit history as unreleased, generating changelogs with 100+ entries; fix by creating tags at the intended baseline SHA

HealthController is excluded from the NestJS Swagger module (generate-openapi.ts) because it depends on TypeOrmHealthIndicator which requires a real DB connection — the health endpoint schema is defined manually in the script instead
The phase 41 discussion log specified monotonic (major.minor) versioning for web and desktop apps, but the implementation used semver throughout; user accepted semver for now
commit type prefix matters for release-please: `fix:` triggers patch version bumps across affected packages; `chore(ci):` does not
pr-release-preview.js did not filter merge commits, causing them to be parsed as conventional commits and generating false release labels across unrelated packages
openapi.json is listed as an extra-file in release-please-config.json using jsonpath (`packages/api-client/openapi.json["$.info.version"]`) so nested JSON fields get bumped automatically

code.finding: Health endpoint schema is manually defined here because HealthController can't be instantiated without TypeORM; the version field was not included in the initial manual schema and had to be added
Uses `join(__dirname, '..', 'package.json')` to read version — one level up from src/
Originally used `join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'package.json')` — two levels up from src/health/; refactored to shared src/version.ts module
Commit loop needed a merge commit filter: skip commits where `parents.length >= 2` to avoid false conventional commit matches
New shared module created to centralize API_VERSION reading from package.json, used by both main.ts and health.controller.ts

workflow: Bootstrap release-please by creating git tags at the baseline SHA, then pushing with `git push origin --tags`, then re-running the workflow — the PR regenerates with only post-tag commits
Cargo.lock updates via `cargo update` pull in unrelated transitive dependency upgrades; use targeted workspace-only updates to avoid churn
Force-pushing a rewritten commit to squash `fix:` into `chore(ci):` before merge avoids triggering release-please version bumps for CI-only changes
pnpm api:generate runs: openapi spec generation → orval client generation → tsup build → lint:fix; run after any API schema changes and commit the resulting model file changes

friction: Cargo.lock regeneration via `cargo update` pulled in unrelated transitive dependency upgrades when only the workspace crate version needed bumping
commit message prefix `fix:` was used for PR review fixes, triggering unwanted release-please patch bump labels; required a force-push to squash and rewrite as `chore(ci):`
Auto-merge on PR #428 appeared to be configured but `autoMergeRequest` was null in the API — required manual merge despite the UI indicating it was enabled
A background task notification fired for a failed commit that had already been handled manually, causing minor confusion
Merge commits in the PR caused false positives in conventional commit parsing, adding spurious release labels to unrelated packages before the filter was added
open_items: Generated API client model files from the final `pnpm api:generate` run (healthControllerCheck200Details, healthControllerCheck200DetailsDatabase, healthControllerCheck200Error, models/index.ts) are modified but not yet committed or included in PR #429
Monotonic versioning for web and desktop apps (as specified in phase 41 discussion log) was deferred — semver is currently used for all packages including apps
The openapi.json formatting churn (compact vs expanded JSON arrays) from regeneration with the new version source was absorbed without cleanup — may reappear on next regeneration
